title: a-claim-carries-its-provenance
owner: akiendelllinux_cc_0 (CC) gates writes. Akien approved the direction 2026-08-05 evening ('i'm good with those. yes') after CC recommended it INSTEAD of his own proposal to ticket document changes
intention: An authored DEFINITIONAL claim carries, in the artifact that holds it, whether it is Akien's words or CC's read — and a sieve reds when such a claim has propagated into a second artifact with no provenance. The label must travel with the copy, because the copy is where it was lost both times.
why: Twice in two days a claim of CC's went uniform across the whole corpus and only Akien reading prose caught it. 2026-08-04: node and leaf collapsed into one thing, written that way in the brief, the paper, the ticket and the running store. 2026-08-05: FINDING/VERDICT/DIAL promoted out of the inspector into the learning block, written that way in the learning_block charter, skill_block, the migration ticket and brief §3, with nine skill migrations queued behind it. press_office/proofs/PROOF.md already drew the lesson at n=1: 'the error was mine and consistent across every artifact, so no amount of internal cross-checking would have surfaced it. Only the author reading it did.' The lived symptom is Akien's, both times, and it is the same sentence: he reads a document written under his name and finds a definition in it that he never gave. What makes it costly is not the error but its silence — it propagates at full confidence, wearing no mark that anyone ever wondered.

Law 4 — the SEAM label was policy, and policy is exactly what did not survive a copy; the enforcement owed is physics
Law 1 — 'is this his or mine?' was answered once, correctly, and then re-derived wrongly four times downstream

falsifier.proves_red: FALSIFIER, RED by physics on any of: (1) a definitional claim appears in two or more authored artifacts where none carries provenance to a verbatim or an explicit CC's-read marker, and the sieve does not red; (2) the sieve reds on a claim that DOES carry provenance in either direction (a false positive is the alarm-fatigue failure the andon literature names, and it kills the instrument faster than silence); (3) the sieve is prose in a SKILL.md or a charter rather than a runnable check — discipline wearing physics' clothes, which is the exact defect that let the SEAM label rot; (4) it runs only over one root, so a claim crossing cairn/ into CairnCommons/ escapes. HORIZON: re-read at the next corpus-wide correction. If a third instance of this shape lands (n=3) while the sieve is built and green, the sieve is measuring the wrong property and the node re-enters design rather than getting a patch.

children: two, and the order is forced by assumption (2). (a) THE PROVENANCE FIELD — authored artifacts gain a place to record 'his words' vs 'CC's read' per claim, borrowing chart's per-field shape; without a field to read, the sieve has nothing to check and would only ever measure absence. (b) THE SIEVE — the propagation check that reds when a definitional claim reaches a second artifact bare. It berths after decisions/2026-08-05-filters-become-sieves confirms, because that ruling names the family.

questions.a: A TICKET FOR DOCUMENT CHANGES WAS CONSIDERED AND REJECTED, and the reasoning is kept because the proposal was Akien's and it was a good instinct pointed at the wrong mechanism. His version: ticket every document change, which forces an orientation during /sail. Why it fails against BOTH measured instances: an orientation checks a change against the corpus, and in both cases the corpus was uniformly wrong, so orientation would have compared the edit to four artifacts that agreed with it and gone GREEN. That is a check that could not have failed, now carrying a seal — strictly worse than no check, because the next reader cites it as evidence. He agreed: 'i'm good with those. yes.'

WHAT ACTUALLY DETECTS THIS CLASS TODAY IS AKIEN READING THE DOCUMENT, twice out of two. That is not luck: he is the only oracle standing outside the corpus, and prose is what forces a claim into a shape he can recognise as wrong. The brief is therefore already an instrument and should be treated as one. This node does not replace that loop; it tries to catch the cheap half earlier so his reading is spent on the hard half.

cairn/machines/chart/ per-field provenance is PRECEDENT, not collision — same principle, different surface (a packet's field in flight vs an authored claim at rest). Borrow the shape; in-house prior art beats external.

how: Add a provenance field to authored definitional claims (charter, decision) — 'akien' or 'cc-read'. Build a sieve in build_inspector that reds when a definitional claim has no provenance. Children decompose the field and the sieve.

filed_edges: [CORPUS] IS A DEFINITIONAL CLAIM MECHANICALLY SEPARABLE FROM A DESIGN STATEMENT? 'An inspector is a kind of learning block' is a definition; 'the engine is branchless about blocks' is a design statement. The sieve's whole feasibility rests on telling them apart at acceptable false-positive cost. Unmeasured. BUILDME measures it first; if it cannot, the fallback shape is a DECLARED-CLAIMS REGISTRY (the author marks the claim) rather than a detector (the scan finds it) — a different build, so this question is load-bearing before any code.

[CORPUS] WHAT COUNTS AS A SECOND ARTIFACT? The corpus spans two repos, JSON charters and markdown prose, and a QUOTATION of a claim is not a PROPAGATION of it — notes/held-learning-blocks-everywhere.json quotes the wrong anatomy today, correctly, above a supersede marker. A sieve that cannot tell quotation from assertion will red on every record of truth in the corpus.

[AKIEN] WHERE DOES IT BERTH? decisions/2026-08-05-filters-become-sieves is UNCONFIRMED, and it names the inspection family's word and its shared library. This node deliberately names a behaviour and not an address. THE SELF-INSPECTION HALF OF THIS QUESTION IS DISSOLVED, 2026-08-06: it read 'if this sieve inspects authored artifacts, and its own charter IS an authored artifact, decisions/2026-08-05-an-inspector-may-not-depend-on-what-it-inspects applies to it directly' — and that packet is retired, ruled conceptually false by Akien ('it's not physics. it's how things happen to be at the moment'). A sieve inspecting its own charter is not forbidden by anything; it is a trained self-inspection with no second line behind it, which is a design note, not a blocker. Only the berth question survives.

[CORPUS] THE /sorted DOOR ACCEPTED THIS SPEC WITHOUT ITS `probe` FIELD and the corpus check caught it minutes later — see troubles/the-sorted-door-checks-five-fields-and-the-gate-needs-six. The berth this ticket carries (sorted_berth) therefore records a packet whose watchme is one field short of what the emission gate will demand. The TICKET is the record of truth the gate reads, and it is correct now; the berth is a record of the firing as it happened and is deliberately NOT edited (Law 7).
